Ivy (partnerships): Flagging repeated overlap: SI referral vs AE inbound for same account. Need a simple deterministic flow for intake, short claim window, and co-ownership tag. Proposing 48h SI claim window + AE priority if AE owner has touched account in last 60d.

Dan (AE): 48h ok. "Touched" = logged CRM activity?

Rina (partner-ops): Yes, CRM activity or /partner-touch shortcut. Intake will include source_detail and partner_ref. If missing canonical_account_id, route to account-validation queue.

Omar (si-lead): From SI ops: if SI evidence (email snippet or signed intro) predates AE touch, SI gets intro credit. If both touch within 48h -> tag co_owned.

June (revops): Need event log: intro_ts, first_touch_ts, partner_id, actor_type. RevOps will run attribution batch. Also capture contract_override flag.

Ivy (partnerships): OK action items: Rina enable staging rule for 48h window; add Slack alerts for conflicts to #partners-intake; Omar update SI onboarding with evidence templates; June produce sample attribution report. Pilot next 2 weeks for two strategic SIs.

Dan (AE): Thx — will try the slash shortcut when I do quick discovery calls.

Rina (partner-ops): Will post daily dedupe CSV to #partners-intake during pilot.

Ivy (partnerships): Great. Success metrics: <4% unresolved duplicates, median resolution <36h. Reconvene after pilot.
